turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Lakeview Dental. I'm an AI assistant. Can I get your first and last name?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: without a word peter got up and lit his lantern

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. And what's the best phone number to reach you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: the first howls were taken up and echoed and with quickening repetitions he lay patiently fighting for breath like a child with croup

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me read that back. Is that right?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. And briefly, what's the reason for your call?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: there are only three sledges left he whispered she asked peter to wait a moment and when she came back from the kitchen she brought a bag of sandwiches and doughnuts for us

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'm going to connect you with someone on our team who can help right now.
